name: Pseudovermidae

img.author: Martynov, A., Lundin, K., Picton, B., Fletcher, K., Malmberg, K., Korshunova, T. 2020. Multiple paedomorphic lineages of soft-substrate burrowing invertebrates: parallels in the origin of Xenocratena and Xenoturbella. PLoS ONE. 15(1): e0227173. DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0227173

desc: Pseudovermidae is a taxonomic family of minute nudibranchs, marine gastropod molluscs or micromolluscs, within the superfamily Cumanotoidea.
